### Implementation Summary & Craft Details:

Incorporated the official `BinanceNova` web font family (Regular, Medium, SemiBold) and exact source palette: dark baseline `#181A20`, surfaces `#202630` and `#29313D`, card fill `#252C37`, pale type `#EAECEF`, muted type `#929AA5`, and brand gold `#F0B90B` / yellow `#FCD535`.
- **64px Compact Header & Mobile Drawer**: Contains the gold Binance wordmark at left, Log In, Sign Up, and hamburger toggle. Expanding the drawer presents the 9 public navigation sections (`Buy Crypto`, `Markets`, `Trade`, `Futures`, `Earn`, `Square`, `Institutional`, `AI`, `More`).
- **Hero & Metrics (y:64–1223)**: Condensed 3-line mobile typography (`332,870,856`, `USERS TRUST US`, `The World’s Leading Cryptocurrency Exchange`), the two No.1 distinction cards with the original mobile gold laurel artwork (`dark-left-mobile.svg`), ISO/IEC 27001 & SOC 2 badge, registration input, and native Google/Apple social sign-ins.
- **5-Row Mobile Market Panel**: Tabbed with `Popular`, `New Listing`, `Stocks`, and `tCommodities`. Features all 5 mobile rows—**BTC**, **ETH**, **BNB**, **SPCXB** (bStocks), and **NVDAB** (bStocks)—with accurate dated prices, percentages, Forbes & Fortune recognition badges, and official news announcements.
- **Campaign Banner (y:1223, 210px)**: Authentic mobile carousel container referencing the official campaign artwork and pagination indicators.
- **SAFU Section (y:1433–2589)**: Headline `FUNDS ARE SAFU`, 15,000 BTC reserve card with clickable explorer destination for wallet `1BAuq7Vho2CEkVkUxbfU26LhwQjbCmWQkD`, verified stats (7,488,223 users helped / $229,433,449 recovered), and customer protection team portraits (`humans-luis-thumb.png`, `humans-mohit-thumb.png`, `humans-dennis-cn.png`).
- **Mobile App Download (y:2589–3285)**: Centered `Trade on the go. Anywhere, anytime.`, official mobile dark phone preview graphic, and App Store / Google Play download badges.
- **Complete FAQ Region (y:3285–4213)**: Centered heading and all 10 interactive disclosure rows with numbered tags, plus toggle icons, full verbatim answers, and embedded official hyperlinks.
- **Final CTA & 6-Group Collapsible Footer**: 136px CTA block with `Secure, Low-Fee Trading on Binance` and yellow `Sign Up Now`, community social icons, the 6 accordion groups (`About Us`, `Products` [including Card], `Business`, `Learn`, `Service`, `Support`), regional/currency/theme toggles, and ADGM legal/regulatory disclosures.
